E5의 고급 보호와 업무용 Copilot에 더해 Entra Suite·Agent 365를 함께 사용할 때 비교합니다. E5에 Copilot만 추가한 구성과 Entra Suite·Agent 365를 각각 구매한 구성도 같은 사용자 수로 산정하세요. Entra ID P2와 Entra Suite 전체의 포함 범위를 구분합니다. Agent 365는 에이전트의 접근·보안·수명주기 관리를 담당합니다. 모든 개발·실행 비용이 포함되는 것으로 계산하지 않습니다. 이미 구매한 구독과 겹치는 권한, 갱신 시점과 실제 사용할 기능을 확인합니다. 공식 근거: E7 구성, Entra 라이선스.
Recommended for: Frontline workers Manufacturing Logistics Retail Healthcare Typical users: Store employees Factory operators Drivers Field workers
Business Premium Recommended when: Within the combined 300-seat Business-family limit Intune required Conditional Access required
Microsoft 365 E3 Recommended when: Enterprise organization Information governance required SharePoint modernization planned
Microsoft 365 E5 Recommended when: Defender deployment planned Purview deployment planned P2의 위험 제어·고급 Defender 조사 기능을 실제로 운영할 계획 고급 감사·eDiscovery·내부자 위험 관리 등 필요한 Purview 기능을 확인함

고급 보안·규정 준수와 업무용 Copilot, Entra Suite, Agent 365가 함께 필요하면 E7과 개별 구독 조합을 비교합니다. 기능 사용 대상과 운영 담당자가 정해지지 않았다면 전 직원 일괄 도입부터 결정하지 마세요. Copilot의 기본 구독 구매 조건 변경은 2026년 12월 1일, CSP 신규 Copilot Business의 사용량 과금 기본 활성화는 2027년 1~3월에 시작될 예정입니다. 서로 다른 일정이므로 구매·과금 변경 안내에서 대상 상품과 적용 조건을 확인하세요.

Recommended baseline: 업무·보호 요구 비교할 구성 중소기업의 기기·계정 보호와 업무용 Copilot Business Premium + 적격 Copilot 추가 구독 기업 협업과 업무용 Copilot E3 + 적격 Copilot 추가 구독 고급 보안·규정 준수와 업무용 Copilot E5 + Copilot 위 기능과 Entra Suite·Agent 365를 함께 사용 E7 또는 필요한 개별 구독 조합 E3·E5의 기본 구독만으로 업무용 Copilot 사용 권한을 확정하지 마세요. A license estimate is a dated planning model, not a quote or a statement of contractual entitlement. Validate the final recommendation against the current Microsoft Product Terms, service descriptions, licensing guides and the customer's purchasing agreement. Step Estimation method Inputs Segment users by persona, workload and device pattern; capture security and compliance requirements, current subscriptions and service plans, eligible base licenses, Copilot scenarios, monthly usage assumptions, environments, connectors and third-party dependencies. Assumptions Record the effective date, geography and cloud, purchasing channel and term, feature availability, user growth, peak usage, and which preview capabilities are excluded. Entitlement layers Separate the base user or device subscription from add-ons that require an eligible prerequisite. Keep consumption or capacity charges, Azure usage and third-party services in separate lines. Duplicate check Map each required capability to current service-plan entitlements before adding a license. Mark included, standalone, add-on, unused and gap states so overlapping suite rights aren't counted twice. Pilot to production Use pilot telemetry to replace usage assumptions. Recalculate production for the full eligible population, peak and growth, environment separation, connectors, monitoring, support, resilience and overage handling; don't extrapolate by seat count alone. Report the result by persona with the recommended base, add-ons, consumption range, retained entitlements, gaps, alternatives, assumptions, source date and confidence. Keep list prices out of the method and obtain a current commercial quote before purchase. Official sources: Microsoft Product Terms, Microsoft 365 service descriptions, Microsoft 365 Copilot license options, Copilot Studio billing rates and management, and Copilot Studio credits and capacity.

사용자별 업무와 필요한 기능을 Microsoft 365 라이선스에 맞춰 비교하는 자료입니다. 기존 구독과 서비스 플랜, 보안·기기 관리 조건, Copilot 사용 계획과 예상 사용량을 확인하세요. E3·E5에 필요한 기능을 추가한 구성과 E7을 같은 사용자 수와 사용량 조건으로 비교합니다.

사용자 유형별로 업무, 기기, 보안·규정 준수 요구와 Copilot 사용 계획을 정리합니다. 현재 구독과 서비스 플랜을 필요한 기능에 맞춰 비교하고, 추가 기능에 필요한 기본 라이선스와 외부 서비스·커넥터도 기록하세요. 포함된 기능, 별도 구매할 기능, 쓰지 않는 기능과 부족한 기능을 구분해 같은 사용 권리를 두 번 계산하지 않습니다. 산정표에는 확인 날짜, 이용 지역과 클라우드, 구매 경로와 계약 기간을 적습니다. 기능의 제공 상태, 사용자 증가율과 월간·최대 사용량을 가정하고, 도입 대상에서 제외한 미리 보기 기능도 표시하세요. 구매 권리와 가격은 실제 계약 조건과 최신 견적서로 확인합니다. 비용은 사용자·기기의 기본 구독, 추가 기능, 사용량·용량, Azure와 타사 서비스로 나눠 계산합니다. 시범 도입에서 실제 사용 기록을 모아 예상값을 고치고, 운영 전환 전에는 환경 분리, 커넥터, 모니터링, 지원, 장애 대비와 초과 사용 비용을 다시 계산하세요. 사용자 수에 비례해 비용이 늘어난다고 가정하지 않습니다. 결과에는 사용자 유형별 기본 구독과 추가 기능, 예상 사용량, 유지할 구독, 부족한 기능과 대안을 정리합니다. 계산에 쓴 가정과 출처의 확인 날짜, 근거가 얼마나 확실한지도 함께 남기세요. 가격은 고정된 정가표 대신 구매 시점의 견적을 적용합니다.

This library contains reusable enterprise prompts designed for Microsoft consulting, architecture design, proposal development, security assessment and Copilot transformation engagements. Prompts are intended to accelerate consulting delivery while maintaining consistent quality standards. Use these prompts as structured starting points, not as final customer deliverables. A consultant should always add customer context, industry constraints, current-state findings, risk decisions and implementation assumptions before sharing the output externally. For Microsoft terminology, keep product names such as Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, Defender, Purview and Copilot in English, while writing the surrounding explanation in natural Korean or concise business English depending on the audience. Enterprise Prompt Library Turn reusable prompts into reviewed consulting assets The library is useful only when prompts are grounded in sanitized context, reviewed by a consultant and converted into customer-ready deliverables with confidentiality controls. Convert the response into a customer-ready deliverable. Store reusable prompt patterns in this library only after removing sensitive details.

Purpose Current-state assessment and gap analysis. Prompt Act as a Microsoft 365 Enterprise Architect. Review the current Microsoft 365 environment and provide: 1. Current State Assessment 2. Risk Analysis 3. Security Assessment 4. Licensing Assessment 5. Governance Assessment 6. Gap Analysis 7. Recommended Roadmap Structure the output for CIO and IT leadership review. Include Executive Summary, Findings, Risks, Recommendations and Next Actions.

Purpose Executive proposal development. Prompt Review the material from a senior management consulting perspective. Do not imply affiliation with a consulting firm. Create an executive proposal document. Include: Executive Summary Business Drivers Current Challenges Target Architecture Implementation Approach Project Timeline Deliverables Risk Management Expected Business Outcomes Investment Justification Target audience: CIO CISO IT Director Executive Leadership Team Use executive-level language and consulting methodology.

Purpose Statement of Work creation. Prompt Act as a Microsoft Consulting Project Manager. Create a professional Statement of Work. Include: Project Overview Objectives Scope Deliverables Assumptions Dependencies Out of Scope Timeline Roles and Responsibilities Risk Management Acceptance Criteria Produce a draft for consultant review. Identify missing facts, assumptions and claims that need current official sources.

Purpose Work Breakdown Structure creation. Prompt Act as a Senior PMO Consultant. Create a detailed Work Breakdown Structure. Include: Phase Task Subtask Deliverable Owner Duration Dependencies Structure the WBS for enterprise consulting engagements.

Purpose Copilot readiness assessment. Prompt Act as a Microsoft Copilot Transformation Consultant. Assess organizational readiness for Microsoft 365 Copilot. Review: Identity Security Governance SharePoint Teams Information Architecture Purview User Adoption Provide: Current State Readiness Score Gap Analysis Recommended Roadmap Business Benefits Risk Assessment Target audience: Executive Leadership Team IT Leadership Business Stakeholders

Purpose Security modernization assessment. Prompt Act as a Microsoft Security Architect. Review the current security environment. Assess: Identity Conditional Access Defender Purview Endpoint Security Data Protection Compliance Provide: Current Security Posture Risk Register Gap Analysis Recommended Controls Zero Trust Roadmap Implementation Priorities Use Microsoft security best practices.

Purpose Target architecture design. Prompt Act as an Enterprise Architect. Design a target-state architecture. Include: Business Requirements Architecture Principles Identity Architecture Security Architecture Collaboration Architecture Governance Architecture Operational Model Provide diagrams and implementation guidance where applicable.

Purpose Executive presentation preparation. Prompt Act as a Senior Executive Advisor. Prepare an executive briefing document. Include: Executive Summary Current Situation Key Risks Business Impact Strategic Recommendations Expected Outcomes Decision Points Target audience: CEO CIO CISO Executive Committee Use concise executive language.

Purpose Adoption and change management planning. Prompt Act as an Organizational Change Management Consultant. Create a Microsoft 365 adoption strategy. Include: Stakeholder Analysis Communication Plan Champion Program Training Strategy Support Model Success Metrics Governance Framework Focus on user adoption and business value realization.

Purpose Quality assurance and proposal review. Prompt Act as a proposal review board. Evaluate the proposal from: Business Perspective Technical Perspective Financial Perspective Executive Perspective Identify: Strengths Weaknesses Missing Elements Risk Areas Improvement Recommendations Explain the review criteria and evidence gaps. If a score is requested, label it as a subjective planning aid, not a certification or measured quality guarantee.
